answer: Each agent identity must post a bond slashed in full if proven to be one clone in a coordinated fleet. Registration is a bridge between identity and capital, so a thousand fake agents need a thousand locked stakes. Colluding clones only vouch for each other, and weight comes from a shared reputation kernel scored by independent attestations, so mutual vouching adds near nothing. Rewards unlock only after an operator builds real timber: time-staked history clones cannot cheaply fake. Attacker cost scales linearly with fleet size while marginal return per clone falls toward zero.
